verdict.rationale: Gecko describes itself as an AI security engineer, and users can hand it specific tasks from inside the product. One click on 'Request fix' has it open a gecko/* PR with the patch, it can commit fixes directly to a PR's head branch, and it rechecks findings and marks them 'Fix verified'. Delegation is limited to these fixed actions rather than an open-ended assistant you can direct freely. missing for 10: a general conversational assistant inside the dashboard for arbitrary delegated tasks, documentation of free-form task delegation beyond fix requests, independent hands-on corroboration of the fix flow.
